## Context (placeholder)

Maintainer-facing reporting and analytics over the central telemetry store (Epic e7f3-2b45-8d7d-4c68 umbrella). The umbrella ships a validation-grade stats-retrieval CLI sufficient to confirm data is flowing; this placeholder is for the full reporting investment justified once 1-2 weeks of data is accumulated.

## Scope (to be brainstormed)

Likely components: dashboard or notebook-style report covering per-reviewer ROI (cost-per-valid-finding), severity-band hit rate, cross-reviewer agreement, cycle-K arbiter ruling distribution, adapter coverage by language stack, resolver outcome distribution per author class. May extend `/dso:review-stats`. May involve DuckDB queries packaged as templated commands.

## Dependencies

depends_on e7f3-2b45-8d7d-4c68 (umbrella). Investment justified only after 1-2 weeks of post-deployment data shows what the high-value queries are.

To be brainstormed: `/dso:brainstorm <this-epic-id>` after the umbrella ships.
data.title: Code review telemetry reporting/dashboard placeholder
